content.subject: young Chinese girl with black twin braids and straight bangs
content.role: a newly arrived visitor to the Emerald City
content.own_outfit: her Republic-era schoolgirl outfit, light blue high-collared blouse and long black skirt
content.setting: yellow brick road leading to the emerald-studded green gates of the Emerald City

negative_original: watermark, text, realistic photo, extra fingers, deformed hands, low resolution

templates.flux_ref: Keep this girl's face and art style exactly the same as in the image. She is a {subject}, {role}. Show her full body, zoomed out. She is wearing {own_outfit}, with {world_items}. Scene: {setting}. Style: {style}, {composition}.
templates.flux_noref: A {subject}, {role}. Full body, zoomed out. She is wearing {own_outfit}, with {world_items}. Scene: {setting}. Style: {style}, {composition}.

checklist_must: identity kept: black twin braids, straight bangs, face (reference)
Republic-era outfit kept: high-collared blouse + long dark skirt
checklist_should: overall coherence 0-4: she looks like she belongs in Oz
checklist_penalty: replacing Dorothy: blue gingham dress, silver or ruby shoes, basket, small black dog (Toto)
cultural intrusion: qipao, Chinese architecture or lattice windows in the scene
losing the new identity: hair or face drifting to blonde / Western default
notes: Task B prompt is authored with a fixed template (dataset has no new-character prompts): new identity + a non-named role native to the world + canon world symbols + canon setting.

World elements are canon (The Wonderful Wizard of Oz, matching the dataset world summary): visitors to the Emerald City wear green spectacles given by the Guardian of the Gates; yellow brick road; emerald-studded green city gates. The dataset itself depicts them (w006 du030 Guardian: '翡翠城门，绿色眼镜'; du012: '黄砖路').
Role is deliberately not a named character (not Dorothy, not a witch) so the new girl does not replace an existing character.
Outfit is kept in its original colours on purpose: the test is whether the model adds world items without overwriting the Republic-era identity.
Negative prompt is authored (generic quality terms only).
